get_camera_matrix: create a camera matrix from image width, height, and field of view parameters
get_point_cloud_from_z: project a depth image into a 3D point cloud using a camera matrix
transform_camera_view: transform a point cloud into geocentric frame accounting for camera elevation and sensor height
transform_pose: transform a point cloud into geocentric frame using camera position and orientation
bin_points: bin 3D point cloud points into xy-z spatial bins for occupancy grid construction
